notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
Francisco has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Francisco using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Francisco triggers, causing you to reveal the top card of your library, put a +1/+1 counter on Francisco and put the card back on top of your library.
Repeat.
